Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap to the second ODI. The West Indian spinners opened up some old scars of Australia and reminded them about their perennial issue. This win has handed them 10 crucial CWC points and now the hosts will be gunning for another 10 points along with the series win on Monday, 26th July 2021. The first ball will be at 2.30 pm local (6.30 pm GMT) but you can join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Kieron Pollard, the victorious West Indian skipper, says it's pleasing to win but he thinks they have some work to do. Mentions that after having Australia 6 down for 45, they didn't put their foot on the accelerator. States that his batting unit didn't make it easy as well and further says that it seems that they don't like to do things the easy way. Calls the performance of his spinners fantastic. He is satisfied with the way his bowlers started the game but again repeats that to let Australia reach 187 was a bit disappointing. Terms Australia's bowling as world-class. Praises Pooran and Holder for their partnership and feels that the former is looking like his old self again. On the role of Jason Mohammed in the team, Pollard replies that it's a catch-22 situation with him as he is playing a role where if you lose a couple of wickets, you want him to bat long. Also adds that Mohammed gives them that sixth bowling option. Signs off by saying that they would look to come up with their best combination in the last match and wants his team to keep improving in all three facets of the game.

Alex Carey, the captain of Australia, says it was an interesting game of cricket and it doesn’t help when you are 5 down for not a lot of runs. Still, Carey is proud that the bowlers got them to a respectable total. Tells that they took some early wickets again and created opportunities. Mentions that unfortunately they could not close the game and he feels that they were probably 20-30 runs short. Feels that spin is going to be a threat on these type of wickets. The Aussie skipper is impressed with the way Wade and Starc put up a fight with the bat. Further says that with the new ball it might spin and bounce a bit more so they need to survive the initial period against the spinners. Lauds all his bowlers and is pumped up for the last match but at the same time, he is looking for improvement in their batting.

Nicholas Pooran is chosen for the Man of the Match award! He starts by saying that he wants to dedicate this to his wife as this is his first half-century since he got married. Tells us that for him it was just about building a partnership and putting up a fight with Jason Holder. Mentions that he backed his strengths and was looking to find the gaps. On his success, Pooran credits that to his hard work and shares that he has been trying a lot of things in the nets. Praises all the bowlers for their good work and is honest to admit that they allowed Australia to get too many runs. Feels that the body language in the field dropped due to that.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the match, Australia were in all sorts of trouble as they were reduced to 45 for 6 inside 13 overs. It was a steady procession for them but the lower order combined and propped up the total to 187. Wes Agar played a vital knock and his record stand with Adam Zampa appeared enough once Australia also dismissed West Indies' top 5 wickets for 72 runs. But as mentioned earlier, the record 6th wicket stand at this venue for the hosts brought the series back on level terms. A word of praise for Akeal Hosein also who created big impact in his first spell.

It was all about fighting! Adam Zampa's double blow had the West Indies reeling at 72/5 and Australia appeared to be running away with the show. However, Nicholas Pooran and Jason Holder got together to stitch in a stand. The Aussies created opportunities but the dropped catch of Pooran when he was on 26 and the runs needed were 65 probably cost them the match. In a small chase, all you need is one big partnership and the 93-run stand between Pooran and Holder saw the hosts through.

A hard-fought win for West Indies! They had to sweat for every run as Australia turned up with full force in the defense of 187 runs. Mitchell Starc was bowling with a lot of fire and venom at the start and he got the better of Evin Lewis and Darren Bravo in one over. The partnership that followed between Shai Hope and Jason Mohammed could be pretty underrated but to keep the danger of Mitchell Starc at bay and form a 36-run stand at that time was no mean task. Shai slowly started to get into his groove, hitting a hat-trick of boundaries against Riley Meredith but then lost his concentration and got bowled after charging the spinner.
FOUR! WEST INDIES WIN BY 4 WICKETS! A flatter full ball around off, Alzarri Joseph goes with the turn and heaves it over mid-wicket for the winning runs. The series is levelled now.
FIVE WIDES! Straying down the leg side, spinning past Joseph's pads, missed by the keeper and by leg slip, racing into the boundary. West Indies are almost there.
Flighted delivery on off, Pooran opens his arms and lofts it on the bounce to long off for a single.
Flatter one on middle, keeps low and watchfully defended by Pooran.
Shorter one on middle, staying low, Pooran does well to defensively push it back to the bowler.
A bit flatter on off, Pooran goes back in to block this one.
SIX! WOW! Tossed up on off, Pooran whacks it inside-out with the spin over extra cover for a biggie. Just 7 needed now!
A yorker in the blockhole, Joseph has his bat down in time as he blocks it to the off side. End of another breathtaking spell by Starc, 10-1-26-3!
In the air... falls safely! Fuller in length and outside off, 142 kph, Pooran plays a mistimed lofted shot towards cover. It clears the infield and they cross.

IN THE AIR...AND SAFE! Starc bangs this one short at 141 kph and the ball bounces a bit higher and takes the handle of Joseph's bat who was looking to defend. The ball falls safely in front of square leg as the batsmen take a run.
Full and straight, well blocked out by Joseph.
BEAUTY! A reverse swinging yorker at 143 kph, just misses the off pole by a whisker as Joseph fails to dig it out.
Length ball on middle, angling into the hips, Pooran tucks it away to mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter one on middle, flicked straight to square leg. 16 needed now off 84 balls!
Tossed up on off, driven to covers by Joseph.

DROPPED! A sharp chance for Wade at first slip but he fails to hang on. Flighted delivery on off, spinning away, Pooran tries to cut way too hard and gets the edge. He is lucky as the catch is dropped by Wade. The ball deflects behind and they cross. Fifty for Nicholas Pooran!
Darted in at the stumps, well defended away by Pooran.

SIX! Tossed up on off, Pooran decides to take it on and whacks it behind the bowler's head. It's not a clean connection but has enough to clear the fence as the long off fielder runs across to his left.
A bit of turn and grip for Turner, pitching on off and turning away, Pooran pulls out of the cut shot.
Length again on off, angling in and nicely blocked. Top over by Starc!
Very quick and full delivery, drifting down leg. Joseph looks to flick but the ball catches the pads and Carey takes it beautifully. Certainly saved a boundary there.
Pitched up outside off, looking to swing it in. Joseph shoulders his arms at it.
Alzarri Joseph arrives in the middle. 23 needed off 93 balls with 4 wickets remaining. Is there some life left?
Jason Holder has been given out lbw. Once again he is quick to take the DRS. No bat is involved on this occasion. Ball Tracker shows that it's clipping the stumps. The onfield decision stays.

OUT! LBW! Length ball around off, angling in at 144 kph, Holder looks to tuck it away on the leg side but misses and the ball crashes into the pads. Starc appeals and the finger goes up. Holder reviews it but it's in vain as the wickets are the umpire's call which means the original decision stands. Can Australia carve an opening now?

NOT OUT! Length again on off, Holder looks to loft it over mid on but gets it off the inside half. It still manages to clear mid on. The batsmen scamper for two but there's a direct hit at the bowler's end. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. Pooran has made it safely back in as we can see in the replays.
A direct hit at the bowler's end. Is Nicholas Pooran gone? No, easily in.
Length ball on top of off, Holder tries to block but it's very quick and hits him on the gloves.
Tossed up on off, driven wide of mid off into the deep for a couple.
Short ball on middle and leg, Pooran makes room and looks to pull but misses the ball. He is hit high onto his pads.

FIFTY for Jason Holder, his 10th in ODIs! What an innings this has been from him! He walked in when West Indies was in a spot of bother but along with Pooran, he has managed to put the home team on top. Slightly shorter around off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
A bit short, hit straight to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, but full, Holder plays it against the spin through covers for a couple and moves to 49!
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, zipping off the surface and holding its line, Pooran pokes at it tamely and is beaten all ends up.
Great timing! Fullish and outside off, Holder pushes it through the gap at covers for one. 30 needed more.
Fuller and on middle, defended off the pads to mid-wicket.

Too full in length on off at 145 kph, Pooran digs it out back towards the bowler who jumps to gather the ball on the bounce. Fails to do so cleanly and palms behind. Pooran spots the chance and calls his partner through for a run.
Fuller in length and on off, NP is forward as he defends it to covers.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Pooran tries to cut but it bounces over his blade.
Flatter delivery outside off, Holder looks for a big shot but then at the last moment he defends it back.
Some turn and bounce outside off, Holder pokes at it and gets beaten. 32 needed more.
Pitches it up and outside off, Pooran drives it square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Good running again! Fullish and on middle, Holder defends it off the inner half to short 45 and his partner calls him through for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven firmly to sweeper cover for one.
Beauty! Excellent bit of grip and spin. Turner lands it full and close to off, Pooran lunges to defend but it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Bowling change. Ashton Turner is back into the attack to bowl his off-spin.
On a length and outside off, Holder gets forward and taps it down to point. A loud shout of no follows. 35 needed more.
Starc hits the deck hard, clocks 144 kph and darts in a length ball on off, Holder dead-bats it on the surface.
Starc changes his angle and steams in from 'round the wicket, he spears in a full ball on off at 140 kph, Holder blocks it safely.
A lovely wristwork by Pooran as he eases a full ball behind square leg and rotates the strike.
Uses the angle of the bowler and runs down a 142 kph length ball to third man for a single.
Starts with a very full ball on middle, Holder covers the line and defends it back.
Mitchell Starc is back on. 2/17 in his 6 overs so far.
Length ball on off, punched off the back foot by Pooran to point.
Shorter one on off, angling away at 142 kph. Pooran lets it be.
Full and drifting onto the pads, Pooran flicks it nicely to fine leg for a couple.
A bit fuller on off, bowled at 142 kph. Holder just taps this one on the off side and a quick run is stolen, excellent calling from Pooran.
WIDE! Straying down the leg this time, Holder looks to flick but misses and a wide is called.
Length ball on off at 141 kph, cut away nicely by Pooran to deep point for a run.
Quick bumper on middle, Pooran watchfully moves his body away from it.
Tossed up on off. blocked out.
Flatter one, spinning down and Holder misses his pull. He is thudded on the pads, Zampa appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Huge shout for an lbw and the finger has gone up. Jason Holder is quick to take the review. Is there some bat? Yup. A big inside edge.

NOT OUT! The googly catches Holder in front and the umpire gives it OUT. However, Holder reviews it straightaway and we can see that it was a big inside edge onto the pads. A sigh of relief for West Indies!
FOUR! Tries to bowl full but serves a full toss on off and Holder lofts it over mid on and finds the fence. Holder looking to finish the game quickly now.
FOUR! Short one on leg stump, easy pickings for Holder who just stays in his crease and whacks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
A tad short around off, cut to deep backward point for a single.

Drinks break! The current stand has bailed out West Indies from troubled waters as Pooran and Holder are doing a great job. Australia had an opportunity to break this nagging partnership but Moises Henriques put down a straightforward catch. 51 needed for a win and it's safe to assume that this is West Indies' game to lose now.
Back of a length around off, angling away at 142 kph, Pooran nudges this one down to third man for a single.
Banged in again at 143 kph, Holder pulls it with authority to deep square leg for a run.
The physio of West Indies comes out now. He will perform the mandatory concussion test on Jason Holder.
Meredith steams in and bangs this one into the deck, Holder looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. Jason has a big smile on his face as he seems fine.
Full and straight at 140 kph, Holder pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length on middle and leg, dabbed into the deck on the leg side by Holder.

Ben McDermott seems to have hurt himself. He collided with the advertising boards and is holding his right ankle. The physio has made his appearance. A few concerned Aussie faces around. Ben is going off the field, the good thing is that he is walking without much discomfort.

SIX! Length ball on middle and Holder just picks this one up and dispatches it over the square leg fence. What a hit! Ben McDermott who makes a wonderful effort to catch it crashes into the advertising boards and injures himself. Hopefully, he's fine. 53 needed more.
Riley Meredith is back for another burst. 0/23 in his 3 overs so far on debut.
Short ball and Pooran pulls it towards long on with some venom for a couple.
Nicely bowled, tossed up around off, Pooran looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! Similar flighted ball on off, this time Pooran absolutely creams it through covers for a boundary.

DROPPED! What a big miss that might turn out to be! Flighted delivery around off, Pooran absolutely hammers this one but straight to Henriques at mid off. The ball goes in and pops out of Moises' hands. Nicholas gets a life. 65 needed more.
Tossed up on off, driven towards the cover region.
FOUR! A long hop on middle, Pooran opens his arms and whacks this one to the deep mid-wicket boundary. 50 partnership up between these two!
Length ball and Holder tucks this one to square leg, Pooran wants a run but is rightly sent back.
Back of a length on the pads, flicked off the back foot to deep square leg by Pooran for one.
IN THE AIR...AND SAFE! Back of a length delivery, Holder is cramped for room while he pulls this one in the air to the vacant mid-wicket area for one.
Pitched up on off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length on middle, played off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Would have been gone! Length ball on top of off, it's tapped towards backward point for a quick run but there's some hesitation and Wade misses the shy at the striker's end.
Turn and bounce outside off for Zampa, Holder pushes at it and misses. 74 needed at the halfway mark!
A flatter googly around leg, Holder doesn't keep it out and gets hit on the pads.
Nicely tossed up delivery, full and around middle, Holder presses forward in defense.
A low full outside off, Nicholas slices it wide of backward point for one.
Flighted and on off, Pooran gets forward and defends it back with a vertical blade.
Floated full ball landing on middle, Holder defends it from the inner half to square leg and Pooran calls him through for a single.
Bowling change. Adam Zampa is brought back in. So far he has 2/22 in 6 overs.
On a length and outside off, guided down to third man for one. The stand moves to 40. 76 needed more.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
FOUR! Controlled edge! A length delivery outside off, Holder gets forward, hangs his bat out and gently guides it late down to third man for a boundary.
Marsh keeps it on a length and close to off, Holder stays back and defends it to short cover.
This one is served on the pads, Pooran helps it in front of square leg for a single. 1000 runs in ODIs for Nicholas, becomes the 3rd fastest West Indian to reach this feat!
Slants across a length ball outside off, 133 kph, Pooran goes back and dabs it down to backward point.
Now, Holder nearly chops it on. Back of a length ball on off, 133 kph, Holder tries to work it around but it takes the inside half and rolls past the stumps.
Very full and around off, Holder pushes it down off the front foot to mid off.
Shortish and outside off, Pooran punches it sweetly through point for a single.
Almost a drag on! Extra bounce, on a length around off, Pooran defends it from the inner half and the ball just beats the stumps.
Almost edges it behind! Good length ball outside off, holding its line with extra bounce, Pooran wants to punch but it beats the outside edge.
Angles in a length ball on off, Pooran moves back and taps it down to point.
On a length and outside off, it's left alone by Holder. Two boundaries from the over, 83 needed more.
FOUR! Marsh overcompensates with his line and length. Delivers it full and down the leg side, Holder neatly deflects it off his pads and finds the fence at fine leg.
FOUR! Boom! That's nice from Holder. Shortish length ball on off, nicely sitting up, Holder rides the bounce and hammer-pulls it over mid-wicket. 100 up!
Three dots. Required rate though is not an issue for them. Full and on off, Jason pushes it to covers.
Good length ball on off, defended back towards the bowler.
Starts by landing a full ball on off, Holder defends it by getting forward.
Bowling change. Mitchell Marsh into the attack for the first time today.
Extra bounce, on a good length outside off, Pooran flirts with it and misses. This stand is 25 now, 91 needed off 174 balls.
Shortish and outside off, NP tries to slam it through the line but gets a bottom edge.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, Holder tabs it down to the right of the keeper for a run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Nicholas punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A lot of YES-NO, YES-NO, mid-pitch shake hands, but eventually they cross. On a length and outside off, Holder dabs it down to short third man for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Pooran plays a cracking cover drive past the diving fielder. The mid off fielder though doe well to stop it from racing away. Only a run.
Bowling change. Wes Agar comes back into the attack.
Wes Agar is back on.
Length ball, bowled into the channel just outside off, shaping away, Holder lets it be.
Full and straight, blocked out by Holder.

Back of a length on the hips at 146 kph, tucked to square leg by Pooran. Wade throws the ball unnecessarily at the stumps at the striker's end with no one backing up, the batsmen get an overthrow. Starc seems unimpressed.
Very full, angling in at the toes, played straight to mid-wicket.
A bit fuller, drifting in on middle and leg, turned to deep mid-wicket by Holder for one.
Full and fast on off, bowled at 142 kph. Holder blocks it from the inner half of his bat.
Too full again and easily pushed to long off for a run by Holder.
Flatter on a length on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single by Pooran.
Tossed up very full on off, played towards long on for one. Under 100 needed now!
A bit shorter around off, Holder tucks it to mid-wicket and it goes on one bounce to the fielder inside the ring.
Very full again on middle and leg, played down to long off for a run.
Tossed up full on middle, driven down to long on for a single.
Full and straight, angling into the pads at 144 kph. Pooran plays it nicely in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Real quick bumper at 146 kph, bowled over middle and leg, Pooran ducks underneath it.
Pitched up on off at 140 kph, hit straight to mid off.
Length ball outside off, Pooran pushes it off the front foot towards cover and sets off for a run, Agar misfields and the batsmen get a couple in the end.
Leg Bye! Length ball on the pads at 142 kph, Holder looks to flick but the ball goes off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Full and straight, bowled at 144 kph. Holder gets his bat behind the ball well.
Mitchell Starc returns for his second spell. 4-1-11-2 are his exceptional figures so far.
Very full and pushed wide, sliced towards short third man where the fielder made a fine tumbling stop.
A flatter one on the stumps, pushed back past the bowler for a run.
Tossed up full on off, Holder presses forward to defend but it takes the inner half and rolls to the leg side.
A quick shorter one around off, Holder opens the face of the bat and plays it wide of slip for a couple.
Tossed up on middle, blocked back by Holder.
Tossed up very full on middle, squeezed to deep point for a run.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot by Holder.
Floated delivery outside off, Holder looks to drive but gets the outside edge down to third man for a couple.
Flighted nicely around off, Holder pushes it to covers.
Full on middle, driven down to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Pooran creams his cover drive but Mitchell Marsh makes an impressive stop.
Darted in at middle and leg, Pooran keeps it out.
Loopy and full outside off, Jason stretches forward and pushes it to covers. Top over by Zampa, 2 runs and a wicket from it.
An optimistic appeal for an lbw! Googly landing full around off, Holder decide to defend it near his front pad and does so off the inside edge. They appeal but to no avail.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Pooran goes back and slaps it in front of square on the off side for one.
A wrong 'un on off, on the shorter side, Holder gets back and eases it behind square leg for a single.
Who will come in at number 7? It's going to be Jason Holder.

OUT! STUMPS SHATTERED! Pollard has been fooled by a well-disguised googly. Zampa is over the moon, pumped up in his celebration. This is a body blow to West Indies. The leggie delivers it on a fuller length close to off, Pollard is forward as he looks to flick but the ball turns back in, sneaks through the gap between bat and pad before cannoning onto the stumps. West Indies in big trouble!
Flighted delivery, full and close to off, Pollard defends it from the inside portion of his bat to mid-wicket.
Very full and around off, it's knocked down to long on for a single. 116 needed off 216 balls.
Loopy full ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Too full in length and outside off, Nicholas drives it to covers where the fielder misfields and they cross.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up ball around off, Pollard slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. It drops in front of the deep fielder and they cross.

DRINKS BREAK! Australia are right on top at the moment. Shai Hope, the set batsman, has just been dismissed and West Indies will have to put together one good partnership to get back into the game. The skipper, Kieron Pollard is the next man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The bowling change has worked. Second delivery in ODI cricket for Ashton Turner and he has a wicket.  The offie delivers it from 'round the wicket and pushes it flat and quick around middle and off, Hope jumps down the track for a big shot but misses the ball completely. The ball straightens a touch after landing and the off stump is tickled. Australia have managed to get rid of Shai Hope.
Floated ball, full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Bowling change. Ashton Turner comes in to roll his arms.
Wrong 'un outside off, Pooran goes on the back foot to play at it late but it beats the outside edge.
Fullish on off, a googly, Shai tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and goes to square leg for one.
A full toss outside off, Hope lofts it over extra cover for a brace.
A googly around off, Hope defends it off his front foot to the leg side.

FOUR! Aerial but safe! Tossed up ball outside off, spinning away, Hope goes down on one knee and drags his slog sweep in the air towards mid on. The fielder there dives but it evades him and finds the fence.
Turning away from the batsman, Hope gets forward in defense and misses.
Shortish and outside off, at 141 kph, Hope taps it down to third man for a run.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for West Indies. A 145 kph bumper, Hope ducks and it's well over the head of the jumping keeper. A boundary.

IN THE AIR... CATCHHHH... Starcy...Starcyyy...that's all the shout echoing in the empty stadium but it falls agonizingly short of Starc. Short in length and around off, Pooran top edges his attempted pull shot and it flies behind square leg. Starc runs across and forward from fine leg but fails to reach there with a dive. A single taken.
Pacy delivery at 144 kph, shortish and around leg, Pooran takes his eyes off the ball as he tries to glance. It possibly takes his gloves and deflects to the off side.
Riley is again very full and outside off, 145 kph, this time Pooran pushes off the front foot, good connection but the placement is off. Straight to the cover fielder.
Meredith goes fuller and closer to off, at 141 kph, Pooran draws forward in his defense.
Fuller in length and outside off, at 146 kph, Pooran plays a lovely front foot cover drive but finds the fielder. Slight fumble but the ball stays near mid off.
Allows the ball to spin away from him and then plays it down to short third man.
Too full in length and on off, driven through covers for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched down to long off for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, it's driven back to the bowler off the inner half of the blade.
Slower through the air, a touch short again, around middle, Pooran gets back and eases it behind square leg for one.
Flatter one, a touch short and on off, the batsman gets back and works it towards mid on for a run.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over, if this match lasts till then.

Bangs this one in outside off, Hope hangs on the back foot to slap it over point but it takes the toe end of his bat and rolls to covers. A single taken. At the end of Powerplay 1, West Indies are 51/3!
No Ball! Fuller and quicker outside off, bowled at 147 kph, Hope drives this one nicely through covers for a couple. The third umpire has called for a no ball...Free Hit to follow!
Length again on middle and leg, this time bowled at 143 kph, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, 144 kph, blocked out by Hope.
Now that's raw pace! Fast bumper, outside off, Hope looks to pull it away, gets beaten comprehensively.
Back of a length on off, bowled at 145 kph, tapped on the off side by Hope.
146 kph, on a length around off, just perfect! The ball takes off and Hope can do nothing about it.
A tad fuller on off, Pooran cuts it nicely to point. A wicket maiden from Zampa!
Pushed a bit flatter, just outside off and again it's the wrong one. Pooran looks to cut but gets beaten.
A bit short outside off, spinning in, blocked out by Pooran from the back foot.

Nicholas Pooran is the new batsman. His form across formats has not been up to the mark of late. Can he steady West Indies? 141 needed off 249 balls. A leg slip in place. Wade is heard saying to Zampa - 'Let him sweep straight up!'

OUT! TIMBER! Zampa has struck in his first over! Tosses this one up on middle, it's a googly and Jason Mohammed doesn't pick it at all, He ends up playing all over it and the ball deflects onto the stumps off the pads. Yet another poor outing with the ball for Jason.
Flatter and fuller on middle, Jason pushes it back to Zampa.
Tossed up very full on middle, played towards point.
Bowling change from this end too. Adam Zampa to bowl his leggies. Can he find a better length than the last match?
A quick bumper over off stump to finish the over, Hope lets this be.
FOUR! PURE CLASS! Pitched up on middle at 142 kph and Hope just plays a scintillating straight drive past the mid on fielder and into the fence.
FOUR! A near yorker on middle at 140 kph, Hope almost falls over in his stance but still does well to dig this one out through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Fast outside off, bowled at 144 kph, a flashy drive comes out from Hope but he gets the thick outside edge to the third man boundary.
Length ball on off, slightly slower at 138 kph. Played towards the cover region by Hope.
Meredith starts with a 144 kph back of a length ball on middle. Hope nudges it onto the leg side.
As expected, there is a bowling change. The speed merchant from Hobart, Riley Meredith, is unleashed into the attack. He is on his ODI debut.
Good bumper over the off pole, bowled at a stingy pace of 145 kph. Jason watchfully moves his body away from the ball. 4-1-11-2, Starc's impressive figures in this spell.
A 147 kph wider delivery outside off, slightly banged into the pitch. Jason lets it be.
Length ball on middle, at 147 kph, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pacy length ball around middle, at 144 kph, played out towards the point region.
Fuller one on off, clocked in at 147 kph and driven beautifully but straight to mid off again.
Pitched up outside off at 144 kph, hit straight to mid off by Hope, without much timing.
Agar finally pulls back his length and bowls this one on middle stump, Jason gets behind the line to block it. 10 from the over!
FOUR! Agar doesn't learn from his mistakes and bowls this one even fuller, in fact, a full toss, Jason latches onto it and smashes it perfectly through covers for another boundary.
Full again around off, driven through covers again by Jason. This time just for a couple.
FOUR! Crunched through the covers by Jason, a half-volley outside off and Jason makes full use of it as he hits it for a glorious boundary.
Back of a length on leg, tucked towards the leg side by Jason.
Full and straight at 138 kph, flicked towards mid-wicket.
A touch short in length and outside off, at 144 kph, Hope plays late and it goes off the toe end to cover-point.
FOUR! That's glorious! Shai fights fire with fire. Starc clocks 149 kph and delivers it wide outside off, the length is full and Hope rifles it over covers for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off at 143 kph, Shai goes on his toes to play it down to third man but only manages to chop it down near the stumps.
Lands it on a length around off at 146 kph, Hope tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and goes to square leg.
Very full in length and wide outside off at 149 kph, Jason reaches out for it and squeezes it through the gap between point and cover-point for a single.
A 148 kph full delivery on the pads, Shai tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It rolls to point where the fielder misfields and Hopes takes a single.
Wide! Starc bends his back and sends across a short delivery wide outside off at 142 kph, Hope tries to slam it over point but misses.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it to the off side.
Full again, around off, Jason Mohammed defends it off his front foot.

In the air...CATCH IT...is the shout...It's safe! Fuller length ball on middle, at 132 kph, Hope tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It flies behind backward point and drops safely. They take a single.
Outside off, the batsman is not interested in playing at that.
FOUR! Nicely timed and placed! Fuller length ball outside off, Shai gets on the front foot and transfers his weight into his drive. Beats extra cover and finds the fence.
Wide! Full and angling down the leg side, Hope tries to flick but misses.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope gets across the stumps to flick but misses. It goes off his pads towards the slip cordon.
Who will come in to bat next? Jason Mohammed walks in.

OUT! DEATH RATTLE! Starc is cock-a-hoop and we are loving every bit of his fiery bowling. This time he cranks up 148 kph and spears in a full ball around off, some swing again in the air as Bravo tries to defend from the crease. Fails to do so as the ball goes past him and destroys the stumps behind. The replays show that Darren was very late and played down the wrong line too. Australia are off to a perfect start!
Wide! Tries to target the pads of the batsman but ends up slipping it down the leg side.
Who will come in at number 3? It's going to be Darren Bravo.

OUT! Lewis is trapped in front and he is not reviewing it. You cannot be more plumb than this. Yet another fiery delivery, very full and on middle, it's speared in at 146 kph, swinging in, Lewis is late in bringing his bat down and is thudded on the pads. A huge appeal is made and this time the finger has gone up. Starc is delighted and jumps in joy! 178 needed off 283 balls.
Wide! Fires a full ball down the leg side at 147 kph, Lewis tries to flick but misses.

Shout for an lbw, not given! A 149 kph delivery, Starc spears in a length ball just outside off and it comes back in a bit off the seam, Lewis offers no shot and is hit high on the back leg. They appeal but the umpire disagrees. The impact could not be an issue here but it hit the batsman too high. Carey decides not to review it.
Delivers it on a length close to off, at 144 kph, holding its line, Evin stands back to push inside the line and misses.
Off the inside edge! Starc slants across a fullish length ball outside off, at 147 kph, Shai attempts for a loose drive away from his body and edges it down to fine leg for a run.
Superb delivery, full and on middle, shaping in at 145 kph, Hope has his bat down in time as he defends it back towards the bowler.
Swing and a miss! Short in length and around off at 132 kph, Lewis tries his best to pull but there is no connection.

FOUR LEG BYES! Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Evin lifts his front leg as he attempts to pull. Misses the ball but it clips his thigh pad and runs down to fine leg for a boundary. It's a no ball too for overstepping. Free Hit loading...
Slightly short in length and wide outside off, Lewis punches it from the back foot but finds point.
Angling in from a length outside off, Shai plays late and runs it down to third man for a run. He is off the mark as well.
Good length ball on off, the batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Edgy! Short in length and outside off, Lewis tries to cut but instead edges it down to third man for a run. Gets off the mark after bagging a duck in the last ODI.
In the channel outside off, Lewis lets it be.
Wes Agar to bowl from the other end. He is yet to pick his first ODI wicket.
Good length ball outside off, angling across at 147 kph, Shai shoulders arms. End of a fiery first over by Starc.
Fullish and on around leg, sliding down, Lewis tries flicking but misses. It deflects off the pads to the leg side and they cross for a leg bye.
Fullish and fired on middle at 148 kph, Lewis defends it back.

NOT OUT! Peach of a delivery by Starc. He darts in a length ball close to off at 143 kph and gets it to nip away from there. Evin is squared up in defense and the ball kisses something before going behind to the keeper. Carey comes up with a diving catch. They appeal, the finger is up and Lewis is quick to take the DRS. The Hot Spot shows a flat line and then as per the protocol, the third umpire checks for the lbw as well. The impact is outside off and it's missing the stumps too. Evin is saved by the technology.

Review for a caught behind. The umpire raises his finger to the appeal from Starc but Evin Lewis reviews it straightaway. We can see on the replay that the ball flicked off the pads and missed the outside edge, so, a good review from Lewis.
Pace and movement for Starc. Delivers it full and outside off, shaping away at 148 kph, Lewis allows through.
The chase begins with a stifled appeal for an lbw! Starc angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Lewis is beaten in pace and is struck on the pads. Going down the leg side.
